translations.web: When they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.
translations.bsb: When the offerings were completed, the king and all those present with him bowed down and worshiped.
translations.kjv: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.
